entities.name: PMID:27489804
observations: 2016 Clinical and Experimental Vaccine Research study titled “QS-21 enhances the early antibody response to oil adjuvant foot-and-mouth disease vaccine in cattle.”
Compared a commercial W/O/W oil-adjuvanted FMD vaccine supplemented with QS-21 against the same oil-adjuvanted vaccine without QS-21 in six cattle per group.
Measured serum virus-neutralization and liquid-phase blocking ELISA antibody titers serially for approximately three months.
The abstract reports a statistically significant early antibody increase with QS-21, especially for virus-neutralizing antibodies.

Type O neutralizing antibodies were detected on day 3 in 4/6 QS-21 cattle versus 3/6 controls; a strong QS-21-group neutralizing response was reported by day 8 and increased through about day 28. Exact titers and P values were not available in the retrieved excerpts.

entities.name: QS-21
observations: Saponin adjuvant added to a commercial W/O/W oil-adjuvanted FMD vaccine in cattle; the study reports enhanced early antibody responses compared with vaccine alone.

entities.name: Foot-and-mouth disease
observations: The cattle study evaluated an oil-adjuvanted foot-and-mouth disease vaccine and type O virus-neutralizing antibody responses.

entities.name: QS-21 early antibody enhancement
observations: In cattle, adding QS-21 to a W/O/W oil-adjuvanted FMD vaccine produced a statistically significant early antibody increase versus the same vaccine without QS-21, with emphasis on virus-neutralizing antibodies.
Type O neutralizing antibodies appeared by day 3 in both groups, in 4/6 QS-21 cattle versus 3/6 controls; the QS-21 group showed a strong response by day 8.
